about.sectionTitle: From the edges of technology into systems that carry real weight.
paragraphs: I started from the edges of technology, between urban memory, village roots, warnets, second-hand PCs, failed early attempts, and a long self-taught path. That path eventually led me into banking-grade systems, finance-domain services, and architecture work spanning web, backend, mobile, and infrastructure.

Today, I deliver complete products across whatever layer the product needs: React/Next.js, Golang microservices, Android mobile, cloud infrastructure. What makes the pace possible is an AI system I built and maintain: personal model routing across providers, automated browser and terminal agents, persistent context across sessions and machines.
My long-term direction is AI-first systems: not AI as a side feature, but AI as an operational layer that reduces friction, preserves continuity, and moves routine execution away from humans.
